candidate_value.notes: Custom study-level appraisal complementing result-specific RoB 2. Computer-generated randomized allocation, concealed sequence and blinded outcome assessment are reported. Published analyses appear to use the 138 completers from 162 randomized participants without a reported ITT or missing-outcome sensitivity analysis. No prospective trial-registration identifier or preserved statistical-analysis plan is reported in the article. The combined arm also received greater total intervention exposure than either single-intervention arm; this limits interpretation of combination superiority but is not itself converted into a RoB 2 domain penalty. This is not a validated external quality score.

candidate_value.estimand_or_result_scope: Effects of randomized factorial assignment to Baduanjin and/or cognitive training on post-intervention change in global cognition.
candidate_value.notes: Outcome-scoped RoB 2 appraisal for the randomized factorial global-cognition result. Stage 5 contains the four factorial cells but no privileged contrast; this appraisal does not create or alter a contrast. D3 is some concerns because 24 of 162 randomized participants were absent from the reported completer analyses without a reported ITT or missing-outcome sensitivity analysis. D5 is some concerns because no prospective registry/SAP is reported for the multiple eligible cognitive outcomes and analyses.
